method: Prefer rune animal → named native monster → actual collectible drop → ov_desc.small_map. Where no suitable direct chain is established, use an explicitly labelled related native non-usable collectible under the updated 2026-10-11 selection policy. Direct chains and related substitutions are distinct evidence statuses. All rune icons must have different decoded visible pixels.
